jackseconomy.ponder.exporting.text_1: Exporters can be used to automate the process of selling items.
jackseconomy.ponder.exporting.text_2: Exporters need manifests to function, without them they are useless.
jackseconomy.ponder.exporting.text_3: Exporters take a while to sell items, so make sure you have enough of them to avoid overflows.
jackseconomy.ponder.importing.text_1: Importers can be used to automate the process of buying items.
jackseconomy.ponder.importing.text_2: Importers need manifests to function, without them they are useless.
jackseconomy.ponder.importing.text_3: Importers take a while to buy items, so make sure you have enough of them to sustain your needs.
jackseconomy.ponder.fluid_exporting.head: Exporting Fluids
jackseconomy.ponder.fluid_exporting.text: Fluid exporters can be used to automate the process of selling fluids.
Fluid exporters need manifests to function, without them they are useless.
Fluid exporters take a while to sell fluids, so make sure you have enough of them to avoid overflows.
jackseconomy.ponder.fluid_importing.head: Importing Fluids
jackseconomy.ponder.fluid_importing.text: Fluid importers can be used to automate the process of buying fluids.
Fluid importers need manifests to function, without them they are useless.
Fluid importers take a while to buy fluids, so make sure you have enough of them to sustain your needs.
Currency converters can be used to convert money into other forms, such as dollar bills to ten dollar bills.
Currency converters don't use power, unlike other machines.
They convert currencies instantly, so no need to wait.
